subject: Susan Eldridge Endorsement of Anna Callahan
overview: Susan Eldridge spoke in support of Anna Callahan's campaign for State Representative, highlighting her community work and policy priorities.

items.title: Introduction of Susan Eldridge
items.summary: An unnamed speaker introduced Susan Eldridge and highlighted her grassroots work with Our Revolution Somerville and the Tufts PILOT program.

items.title: Remarks by Susan Eldridge
items.summary: Susan Eldridge endorsed Anna Callahan for State Representative, citing her commitment to issues such as affordable housing and healthcare.
